method: Second listening-barrier pass through 211–240; reopen the distinction between an audit explanation and a learner-visible card. Retain source ambiguity without silently correcting quotes.
phrases: they're supposed to
they are expected or required to do something
他们应该……；按要求他们要……
They're supposed to send the agenda before the meeting.
按要求他们应在开会前发出议程。
Supposed to + base verb describes an expectation, not proof of compliance. In connected speech the ending of supposed joins to to; do not interpret it as a past-tense guess.
and under
and any smaller amount or lower number
及以下；不超过所说的数量
The activity is for children aged ten and under.
这项活动面向十岁及以下的儿童。
Includes the stated number. Source six beers and under means up to six beers, not physical position underneath; like marks an approximate retelling, not a verified rule.
some sort of
a kind of something whose exact type is unspecified
某种；某一类
There's some sort of problem with the connection.
连接似乎出了某种问题。
Hedges the speaker's precision. Some sort of limitation does not identify the exact restriction; sort is a category noun, not the verb organize.
which is why
and that is the reason that
这就是为什么……；因此……
The train was delayed, which is why I'm late.
火车晚点了，所以我迟到了。
Which points back to the preceding situation, not a single person. The source offers the narrator's causal explanation, not independently demonstrated causation.
everybody knows everybody
people in a small or closely connected circle are familiar with one another
圈子很小，大家彼此都认识
It's a small office where everybody knows everybody.
这是个小办公室，大家彼此都认识。
Informal exaggeration about connectedness, not a literal survey of every pair of people. Type of thing frames the source as an approximate description.
went to insurance
was spent on or allocated to insurance
用于保险；花在保险上
Part of our monthly budget went to insurance.
我们每月预算的一部分用于保险。
Money goes to + purpose/recipient. Per brother per year sets a per-person annual rate; source is an attributed Reddit account, not a verified fee schedule.
The thing is
the important point or difficulty is what follows
关键是；问题在于
The thing is, we don't have enough chairs for everyone.
问题是，我们没有足够的椅子让每个人都坐下。
Discourse opener introducing a complication; not a reference to a physical object. A short pause after is is natural, but no exact audio realization is claimed.
a whole ecosphere
an entire interconnected world or network, used figuratively here
一整个相互关联的圈子或体系
The article describes a whole ecosphere of small businesses around the station.
文章描述了车站周边由小企业组成的一整个相互关联的商业圈。
Figurative extension of an ecological term; ecosystem is a more usual business metaphor. Source describes a specialized legal circle, not a biological environment.

segments: The following checklist 216–224 clarifies BYOB as bring your own beer and identifies the second narrated option. A whole list of BYOB remains awkward source wording: likely a list of requirements, but that missing noun cannot be supplied as a verified quotation. Retain this source issue.

The source's beer expansion is explicit; checklist means a list of required steps. Supposed to now has a transferable card distinguishing expected conduct from actual compliance, rather than relying on an unseen audit explanation.

Read with the assigned door checker, guest list, age threshold and following drink limits. It could refer to a list or an eligibility record; neither the mark nor its object is stated. Do not invent wrist stamping or a specific checking procedure.

The inclusive upper-bound expression now has a learner-facing example. Six refers to number of drinks, not types; or introduces the bottle alternative and like hedges the retelling. No current policy advice is inferred.
Some sort of is an uncertainty hedge now explicitly taught; there refers to the preceding drink rules, not a new location. The source does not claim a precise verified limit.

The ensuing yes and insurance discussion suggest an insure reading, but PDF ensure must remain unchanged. The lexical difference between making certain and providing insurance cannot be approved from topic alone; audio clarification remains needed.

The linking structure now has a transferable example; which resumes the alleged weakness of the checks. The narrator asserts a causal connection; nonstandard there's a lot of things remains only in the original.

Full 230–240 context narrows the question to insurance payments after a member loses coverage. Paragraph 233 gives a purported funding source, not a unique antecedent for them. The question's false start and recipient ambiguity remain; keep the Phrase unapproved.

Figurative specialized network is now explicitly taught as well as accepting cases. Only scopes the lawyers' described specialization; the paragraph does not validate that all such professionals share one practice.
The interconnected-circle expression now has a natural everyday example. One big and type of thing are loose conversational framing; everybody is hyperbolic, not evidence of universal acquaintance.

Spending/allocation sense of went to is now supported rather than implied by an insurance keyword. Per brother per year is the rate for each member each year; which refers to the required payment arrangement in the Redditor's quoted account.

New discourse opener announces a complication. Could marks possibility, being sued is passive, either/or lists claimed alternative breaches, and in which case refers to that condition. The quoted user's broad account is not certified as policy interpretation.
